coupons_value_ck.name: coupons_value_ck
coupons_value_ck.value:
("coupons"."kind" = 'PERCENT' and "coupons"."percent_off" > 0 and "coupons"."percent_off" <= 100 and "coupons"."amount_off_cents" is null)
          or ("coupons"."kind" = 'FIXED' and "coupons"."amount_off_cents" > 0 and "coupons"."percent_off" is null)

coupons_dates_ck.name: coupons_dates_ck
coupons_dates_ck.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" >= "coupons"."starts_at"

finance_entries_paid_account_ck.name: finance_entries_paid_account_ck
finance_entries_paid_account_ck.value: "finance_entries"."paid_on" is null or "finance_entries"."account_id" is not null

finance_entries_installment_ck.name: finance_entries_installment_ck
finance_entries_installment_ck.value: ("finance_entries"."installment" is null and "finance_entries"."installments" is null) or ("finance_entries"."installment" between 1 and "finance_entries"."installments")

stock_movements_sign_ck.name: stock_movements_sign_ck
stock_movements_sign_ck.value:
("stock_movements"."kind" in ('COMPRA', 'ENTRADA') and "stock_movements"."qty" > 0)
          or ("stock_movements"."kind" in ('PEDIDO', 'PERDA', 'CONSUMO') and "stock_movements"."qty" < 0)
          or ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'AJUSTE' and "stock_movements"."qty" <> 0)

stock_movements_purchase_ck.name: stock_movements_purchase_ck
stock_movements_purchase_ck.value: ("stock_movements"."kind" = 'COMPRA') = ("stock_movements"."purchase_id" is not null and "stock_movements"."total_cents" is not null)
